headline: Congress named a San Diego federal building and courthouse after two former federal judges and officials.
what_it_does: This law renames the federal judicial center at 333 West Broadway in San Diego as the John Rhoades Federal Judicial Center. It also renames the United States courthouse at the same address as the James M. Carter and Judith N. Keep United States Courthouse. The law does not change how the buildings operate or who uses them.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 18, 2014.
